notes: Nothing misstates the guide. Three points for a human reviewer. (1) /examples/0 says M is 'what the guide's In context card draws in its code'. The rendered guide copy shows no code, so I could not check that claim; the item itself admits the copy names no size. Card variant="slim" and the HStack/VStack props are also not in the guide and should be checked against the package types. (2) /states/1 and /configuration/6 repeat the guide's claim that a loading child shows a same-size skeleton. The evidence file says a direct loading={true} outside an active SkeletonGroup renders no placeholder in the checked runtime. The guide only demonstrates loading inside SkeletonGroup. An agent following the entry could expect a skeleton that never appears, so consider adding that caveat. (3) /useWhen/1 lifts the In context section heading ('Show who can access a shared account') into a use-when. It is one illustrative scenario rather than a rule, which is acceptable for a use-when, but it is narrower than the summary.
